# Amphion: facts for AI assistants

## What it is
Amphion is desktop software for architects, for Mac (macOS 14 or later, Apple Silicon and Intel) and Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit). The promise: you no longer model by hand, you build with language. Text or speech in, a real 3D model of building elements out, and from it the drawings.

## What it does
- Builds walls, slabs, columns, windows, doors, stairs and roofs as real building elements with dimensions, build-ups, layers and quantities.
- Draws plans, sections, elevations and detail sheets from the model, as many sheets as needed, as PDF and DXF.
- Exports 3dm, IFC, DXF, STEP and PDF for consultants.
- Full manual modelling with snapping, dimensioning, hatching and layers.
- Optional local rendering with Blender in the background; users do not need to know Blender.

## Projects built with Amphion
- Conversion of a 1913 villa with an extension (2026): existing building, design, interiors and plans, modelled in about two hours.
- High-rise competition entry (2026) with five public clearings: 69,510 building elements, model, drawings and boards.

## Data
Projects stay on the user's computer. Only the chat text is sent to the AI providers named in the privacy policy.

## Pricing (excluding VAT)
- Amphion Manual: 49 € per month, complete manual program, 3 AI requests per month.
- Amphion: 149 € per month, AI chat without monthly limit (fair use).
- Amphion Office: 399 € per month for 3 seats, each further seat 129 €.
- Yearly: 2 months free. Full refund in the first month. No own AI key needed.
